sources.description: Folders that contain the SVG files, relative to the config: a path, or { "dir", "include", "exclude" } to pick files by glob (for example from an icon package in node_modules). A single string is one folder. Default "icons".

dir.description: Folder with the SVG files, relative to the config. It may point into node_modules.

include.description: Only files that match one of these globs are icons. Default: every .svg file. Globs on the path inside dir with "/" separators: "house.svg", "arrows/*.svg", "**/arrow-*.svg".

exclude.description: Files to leave out, applied after include. Globs on the path inside dir with "/" separators: "house.svg", "arrows/*.svg", "**/arrow-*.svg".

outDir.description: Where sprite files are written. Default "public/icons". Needs publicPath when set, except under public/, where publicPath is derived (public/sprites gives /sprites).

publicPath.description: URL path the sprites are served from, same-origin. Default "/icons", or derived from an outDir under public/. An https:// URL needs "crossOrigin": "inject".

moduleDir.description: Where the manifest and types are written. Default "svgworm".

flatten.description: Drop folder names from icon names. Default false.

color.description: Per-icon color overrides. The last matching rule wins.

match.description: Glob matched against the icon public name (NFC, "/" separators). The last matching rule wins.

color.description: "auto" classifies the icon, "mono" forces currentColor, "preserve" keeps the colors.

crossOrigin.description: Default "none": sprites are served same-origin with zero client JS. "inject" allows an https:// publicPath on another origin (a CDN) and emits a small loader script that fetches the sprite with CORS and integrity and injects it (ADR-0027). Icons need JS in that mode.
